summary.text: Daniel McCay is a Republican member of the Utah Senate representing District 18 in Salt Lake and Utah counties. He was appointed to the Utah House in January 2012 and was elected to the Senate in January 2019.

paragraphs.text: His official legislative profile lists his profession as attorney and real estate portfolio manager.
McCay holds a bachelor's degree in secondary education and a master's in instructional design from Utah State University and a J.D. from Willamette University.
He sits on the Senate Business and Labor Committee, the Senate Revenue and Taxation Committee and the Senate Rules Committee.
